tier1.text: The sacrum firmly links each hip bone to the spine. The sacrum forms the back of the pelvis, a ring of bone that includes the hip bones. Low in the spine, the sacrum is a triangular bone made of five bones fused into one. The sacrum's wide top bears weight, but its narrow bottom tip does not.

quotes.quote: Each hip bone, in turn, is firmly joined to the axial skeleton via its attachment to the sacrum of the vertebral column.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: sacrum: single bone located near the inferior end of the adult vertebral column that is formed by the fusion of five sacral vertebrae; forms the posterior portion of the pelvis
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: pelvis: ring of bone consisting of the right and left hip bones, the sacrum, and the coccyx
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: Low in the spine, the sacrum is a triangular bone made of five bones fused into one.

quotes.quote: The triangular bone, made up of 5 fused bones of the spine, located in the lower area of the spine between the fifth lumbar vertebra and the coccyx.
quotes.citation: NCI Thesaurus (NCIt), National Cancer Institute, https://ncithesaurus.nci.nih.gov

sentences.text: The sacrum's wide top bears weight, but its narrow bottom tip does not.

quotes.quote: The sacrum is a triangular-shaped bone that is thick and wide across its superior base where it is weight bearing and then tapers down to an inferior, non-weight bearing apex
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.
